"""Frozen-source, configuration-only replication driver; no native inference."""

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import platform
import sys
import sysconfig
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = root / "source"
sys.path.insert(0, str(source / "src"))

from codomyrmex.llm.mlx.profile_report import write_profile_bundle
from codomyrmex.llm.mlx.profiling import profile_cache_configuration

run_name = sys.argv[1]
if run_name not in ("run-a", "run-b"):
    raise ValueError("expected run-a or run-b")
if (root / run_name).exists():
    raise FileExistsError(run_name)
started = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
load_before = os.getloadavg()
report = profile_cache_configuration(
    iterations=50_000,
    repeats=21,
    source_revision=(root / "revision.txt").read_text().strip(),
    source_dirty=bool((root / "git-status.txt").read_text()),
)
paths = write_profile_bundle(report, root / run_name)
receipt = {
    "started_at": started,
    "finished_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "argv": sys.argv,
    "isolated_flag": sys.flags.isolated,
    "python_executable": sys.executable,
    "python_executable_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.executable).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "python_build": sys.version,
    "python_config_args": sysconfig.get_config_var("CONFIG_ARGS"),
    "platform": platform.platform(),
    "load_average_before": load_before,
    "load_average_after": os.getloadavg(),
    "host_conditions": "Shared host; GitVault and other project activity ongoing; thermal state uncontrolled; no affinity or frequency controls.",
    "dependencies": sorted(
        (package.metadata["Name"], package.version)
        for package in importlib.metadata.distributions()
    ),
    "loaded_source_sha256": {
        str(Path(module.__file__).resolve().relative_to(source)): hashlib.sha256(
            Path(module.__file__).read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest()
        for name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items())
        if name.startswith("codomyrmex")
        and getattr(module, "__file__", None)
        and Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(source)
    },
}
with (root / run_name / "execution.json").open("x") as handle:
    json.dump(receipt, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
print(json.dumps(paths, indent=2))
reproduction.public_projection: Machine-local python_executable paths omitted from executions; exact original execution receipts remain hash-bound in the local bundle. Full source archive and installed environment are retained locally, not embedded in this public JSON.
